description: List all plugins in the project, each with its `slug` (unique in the project: the name of the plugin package and the prefix of its commands). A plugin added from the plugin library has a `libraryOrigin` (`null` otherwise) naming its origin entry, its `version`, the entry's `latestVersion` and whether an update is on offer (`updateAvailable`; see library_update_preview). Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).
name: plugins_list
title: List plugins
